item.title: Plasma Cutter
item.description:
A Torchmate CNC plasma cutter sat unused for five years before landing in our shop. Then it became my problem to solve.

STATUS: Fully operational. 34-page SOP published, eight staff trained, in regular use for student and capstone jobs.

item.title: ATmega32U4
item.description:
A custom ATmega32U4 dev board designed in Altium, manufactured by JLCPCB. USB-C fought back. ICSP won.

STATUS: V1.1 built and working over ICSP. USB-C never enumerated; root cause not confirmed.
